DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis (Reiter's Syndrome)

Based on the classic triad of asymmetric oligoarthritis (ankle, now knee), urethritis (pain with urination), and your recent sexual history, I am fairly confident in this diagnosis.
